description:
/admin renders BRD §1.5: stat tiles, two tabular sparklines (queries/day + spend/day, last 30 days, stacked by tier), top-10 users by spend, top-10 sessions by spend.  Replaces the placeholder from 6cedb4d0.

MTD spend projection formula: (MTD spend / days_elapsed_in_month) × days_in_month.  Simple linear; defer fancier forecasts.  See BRD §1.5.

Files:
  - src/app/(admin)/admin/page.tsx  (replace placeholder)
  - src/app/(admin)/layout.tsx  (full <AdminLayout>: amber bar, left rail, content pane — design BRD §3.1)
  - src/app/api/admin/overview/route.ts  (new, JSON)
  - src/components/admin/StatTile.tsx  (new — design BRD §3.2)
  - src/components/admin/TabularSparkline.tsx  (new — design BRD §3.4)
  - src/lib/admin-queries.ts  (new — shared SQL helpers)
  - src/__tests__/admin-overview.test.ts  (new)

Done when:
  - All stat tiles render with real numbers.
  - Both sparkline blocks render side-by-side, last 30 days.
  - Both top-10 tables render with row-click navigation links (404 until 5/6 land, fine for now).
  - 'users at >80% of any budget axis' tile correctly handles usd_limit IS NULL (treats only queries axis when usd unenforced).
  - /api/admin/overview 404s non-admins.
  - Page loads <1s on seeded fixture, <2s on prod's current ~10-row dataset.

Tests:
  - Endpoint contract: mock db, assert response shape.
  - requireAdmin failure → 404.
  - Smoke (manual): visit /admin from a tailnet device, eyeball every tile against parallel psql.
